subject: FieldOps RFI: operator attestation, telemetry egress & signed binaries for air-gapped deployment
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@fieldops.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@fieldops.com, ed.park@fieldops.com
Date: 2026-09-14T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: RFI: operator attestation + telemetry egress list for air-gapped deployment

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the quick look at our onboarding questionnaire last week. As we narrow on an air-gapped deployment for FieldOps, Security has asked for a short, concrete RFI on two things we need to validate before we proceed to procurement:

1) Telemetry/phone-home: list of outbound endpoints/domains/ports your runtime may use (including optional diagnostics, OS package checks, license checks). We need a minimal allowlist.

2) Signed binaries & attestation: process and artifacts for verifying binary provenance in an offline install (checksums, GPG/PKI signatures, reproducible build notes, how to verify when no internet).

Additional items we would like if available: SBOM for the runtime (or how to request one), operator access model (local accounts vs. SSO with connectors), and any formal attestation template you provide for customers to sign/retain.

Can you reply with a short inventory and attachments (checksums/SBOM) and propose times for a 30-minute technical review next week? Our target timeline: procurement decision by 2026-09-25.

Appreciate it,
Alicia Gomez
Security Program Manager | FieldOps Inc.
---
FieldOps procurement: procurement@fieldops.com
CISO: Edward Park <ed.park@fieldops.com>
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@fieldops.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-15T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: operator attestation + telemetry egress list for air-gapped deployment

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear list. Summary and attachments below; attaching a compact evidence pack for your security review. I copied engineering (Irene) and security (Markus) for any deep technical follow-ups.

Quick answers up front:
- Telemetry / Egress: Redwood’s air-gapped runtime makes all telemetry optional. By default an air-gapped install will not attempt any outbound connections. For customer-managed telemetry (optional) the runtime (operator agent) will only call explicitly-configured endpoints; the minimal allowlist for the optional agent diagnostics is:
  • diagnostics.redwood-infra.com (443) — optional, used only for aggregated, anonymized health metrics if you opt in
  • unlock.redwood-infra.com (443) — only for license activation if customer chooses online activation; we support offline license files as an alternative
  • time.redwood-infra.com (123/ntp) — optional; we provide guidance for offline time sync alternatives
- Signed binaries & verification: we publish SHA256 checksums and detached GPG signatures for all release artifacts. For offline validation we provide a signed checksum bundle and a verification script that can be run locally. We also supply instructions for customers to import our signing key into an air-gapped KMS/HSM root-of-trust. Attachments: sbom-latest.json, signed-binaries-checksums.txt, airgap-evidence-index.pdf (index lists all artifacts and verification steps).

Attachments included: sbom-latest.json (SBOM for the runtime components), signed-binaries-checksums.txt (SHA256 + detached GPG signatures), airgap-evidence-index.pdf (index & verification playbook).

Proposed times for a 30-min technical review (PST):
- Tue 2026-09-21 09:00–09:30
- Tue 2026-09-21 14:00–14:30
- Wed 2026-09-22 10:00–10:30

If none of those work, tell us a window and we’ll accommodate. We can also provide a pre-recorded 12-minute walkthrough of the offline install + verification steps if helpful.

Next steps we’ll take internally: Markus will prepare a brief attestation template and Irene will validate upgrade path notes for offline patching and SBOM delivery cadence.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: airgap-evidence-index.pdf (PDF stub), sbom-latest.json (JSON stub), signed-binaries-checksums.txt (text stub)
From: Edward Park <ed.park@fieldops.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@fieldops.com>
Cc: procurement@fieldops.com
Date: 2026-09-16T11:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: operator attestation + telemetry egress list for air-gapped deployment

Olga / Alicia — thanks for the quick reply and the attachments. A few clarifying questions from my side before the call:

1) The GPG detached signatures: can you confirm the key fingerprint and provide the signing key in an armored ASCII file we can import into our air-gapped keystore? We need an explicit fingerprint and a statement of key rotation policy.

2) For upgrades: describe the offline upgrade flow step-by-step (we need to verify no implicit egress or dependency downloads). Specifically: operator uploads packages, verifies checksums/signatures, runs installer — do you support local package repositories?

3) Telemetry toggles: is there a runtime flag or config file to hard-disable all outbound connectivity for operators who want zero-evidence-of-external-calls? If so, documentation reference?

If you can answer these three items in a short email prior to the call it will speed review. Also please include any attestation language you propose for procurement.

- Edward Park
CISO, FieldOps Inc.

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Edward Park <ed.park@fieldops.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@fieldops.com>, procurement@fieldops.com

Subject: Re: RFI: operator attestation + telemetry egress list for air-gapped deployment — packet and call

Edward / Alicia / team — attaching the consolidated packet and answering your questions in brief below; full artifacts available on the linked drive for your records.

1) Signing key: fingerprint = 9A3B 1F2E 7C4D 9B20 D4E3  5A11 2C8F 44AB 6D71 8E2F. Attached: redwood-signing-key.asc (armored ASCII export) and signed-binaries-checksums.txt. Key rotation policy: rotation cadence 18 months; emergency revocation contact: sec-ops@redwood.com. Markus attached a one-page policy (included in the evidence index).

2) Offline upgrades: supported workflow (high level):
  • Customer downloads release bundle (tar) from the distribution media or via a vetted USB transfer;
  • Operator imports redwood-signing-key.asc into the local keystore/HSM;
  • Run checksum verification script against signed-binaries-checksums.txt;
  • Install packages from local repo path (we support local package repos via our offline repository bundle and provide configuration samples);
  • Restart runtime — all steps perform local validation only, no external calls required. Irene validated the detailed playbook and added notes on pre-checks and rollback steps in the drive doc.

3) Telemetry hard-disable: yes — the runtime has an explicit config flag airgap.mode = true which disables all optional outbound services. Documentation reference: https://redwood.docs/airgap#config-flags (linked in the packet).

Call scheduled: Tue 2026-09-21 14:00–14:30 PST (we confirmed this slot). Dial-in and meeting materials linked here: https://meet.redwood.com/fieldops-rfi-20260921.

Next steps: Ben will send the formal attestation PDF and we will share an armored signing key file in a separate email (and via the secured drive link). If procurement needs a tailored legal attestation template, we can loop legal and provide one within 48 hours.

Best regards,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
